rules: Reuse existing architecture inventory candidates; additional lexical matches are discovery candidates only.
Unreviewed entries are unknown, except explicitly categorized generated/test/fixture files.
Reviewed dispositions are bound to exact Git blobs and fail on stale source.
Physical file categories do not establish runtime reachability.
No confirmed_dead or safeToDelete=true records are accepted in this initial classifier.
All historical-path files enter the register, including small text files and binary archives; a historical path does not assign historical_archive automatically.
Supporting-source hashes are enforced where sourceEvidenceBlobs is populated. Older path-only references remain explicitly SNAPSHOT_PATH_ONLY.
Every generated record exposes its source query and unresolved caller, symbol, confidence and replacement state. Missing evidence is not a completed review.
shortlistReason: No low-risk removal has replacement and consumer-absence proof. The maximum is three, not a quota; none is approved now.
